sections.title: Describing a stretch of time
sections.content: To describe a span of time — from one point until another — pair -tól/-től ("from") with -ig ("until"), the same -ig you already use to say "how many" of something up to a point. Unlike most Hungarian suffixes, -ig doesn't harmonize at all: it's always -ig.

items.english: I work from nine to five.

sections.content: You can drop the second óra just like with -kor — kilenctől ötig, not kilenc órától öt óráig, is the natural everyday way to say it.
